description: Lists named Thai venues in a city or area. Use when the user wants specific places rather than totals. Filters: business type, minimum FHRS rating (0-5, integers only). Returns name, address, postcode, rating, last inspection date and the total number of matches. Omitting city searches the whole UK by rating. No phone, opening hours, menu, booking or ordering data is held.

city.description: UK city or area name. Omit for a UK-wide list ordered by hygiene rating.

min_rating.description: Minimum FHRS rating, 0-5. Excludes Scottish venues, which have no numeric rating.

type.description: Business type filter; 'all' includes pub kitchens.

name: search_restaurants
title: Search venues by city
